text:
carlos_customer: Hi, our rerank endpoint started returning 400 for a batch we send. One item in the batch errors. We reproduce locally. Full request body below.

carlos_customer: ```json
{"items":[{"id":"a1","query":"find best docs","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"doc1"}]},{"id":"b2","query":"search","candidates":{"id":"x","text":"oops"},"top_k":"3"}]}
```

carlos_customer: Response: HTTP 400, body: {"error":"Invalid request: candidates must be array at items[1]"}

alice_support: Thanks — can you paste the raw curl including headers and the request_id from response?

carlos_customer: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json
```

carlos_customer: response headers: x-request-id: rq_2a7b, x-runtime: 32ms

ben_engineer: Repro'd with that payload. Server rejects when candidates is object or when top_k is string. Looks like our schema validation is strict but error text points to items[1]. Will submit a small runtime fix to include field path and type expected.

alice_support: Workaround for customer: convert `candidates` to array and ensure `top_k` is integer. I can send a quick patch to their client SDK.

dana_support_mgr: Prioritizing P2 due to customer impact (production traffic failing for 2% of requests). Ben, please link the PR and assign to eng-runtime. Keep customer updated.

infra_bot: Created issue RUNTIME-2145, linked to thread, priority: P2.

ben_engineer: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/142 — adds clearer validation messages and soft-accepts single-object candidates by wrapping into array when header `X-Allow-Lenient` is set. Tests included.

alice_support: Thanks — Carlos, can you test with patched SDK or apply workaround? I'll collect confirmation and close ticket if resolved. :thumbsup:

carlos_customer: applying workaround now, will confirm in 10m.
